gold_escalation_reason_note: The customer says over 50 apps cannot be used until developers upgrade to iOS 11; this is an OS-update compatibility/software issue and is routine to troubleshoot.

The customer asks whether there is a way to disable the screenshot preview; they dislike the feature but do not report it malfunctioning, so this is a routine how-to request.

The customer reports a 'payment failed' message while downloading a game and also cannot sign in to iTunes; the payment failure triggers the billing priority, and the account issue also prevents auto-handling.
